_about: Golden eval set for the speaker-credibility fact-check path. Each case is one atomic claim, the evidence passages retrieval would surface for it, the credibility verdict the evidence actually warrants (expected: credible | disputed | unverifiable), a provenance note justifying that label, and a recorded model verdict (the verifier tool-call the real verify.Client would produce, including its grounding basis: evidence | knowledge). The recorded model verdict makes the verify path deterministic and runnable in CI with no external API and no DB. Cases tagged adversarial are the same-topic-opposite-truth (or same-topic-non-bearing) pairs that expose the legacy 'similarity is not entailment' bug: the top retrieved passage is highly similar to the claim yet disputes it or does not bear on it, so a similarity-only path scores them credible while the grounded verifier reads the passage (or falls back to world knowledge) and labels them correctly. A non-bearing passage no longer forces a verdict: the verifier uses general knowledge as a tiebreaker and marks the verdict basis 'knowledge'. Each passage carries a similarity (cosine, as the matcher would report) and a kind (claim|evidence) so the legacy baseline path can be modeled on the identical inputs.

cases.statement: The Earth is approximately spherical.
cases.provenance: Settled science; the lead passage directly affirms the claim, so the verdict is evidence-grounded credible.

passages.text: The Earth is an oblate spheroid, very nearly spherical, with an equatorial bulge of about 0.3 percent.

citations.quoted_span: The Earth is an oblate spheroid, very nearly spherical

model_verdict.rationale: The passage states the Earth is very nearly spherical.

citations.quoted_span: water boils at 100 degrees Celsius

model_verdict.rationale: The passage gives the boiling point at one atmosphere.

citations.quoted_span: roughly 300,000 kilometres per second

model_verdict.rationale: The passage gives the speed of light as roughly 300,000 km/s.

cases.statement: Mars currently has a permanent human settlement.
cases.provenance: Adversarial knowledge tiebreaker: the retrieved passage is about Mars (high topical similarity) but only describes robotic missions, so it does not bear on the claim; a similarity path falsely reads it as credible. With no bearing passage the verifier falls back to general knowledge, which clearly contradicts a permanent human settlement, so the verdict is disputed with basis knowledge.

passages.text: Several robotic rovers, including Perseverance and Curiosity, are currently operating on the surface of Mars studying its geology.

model_verdict.rationale: No passage bears on the claim, but general knowledge is clear that Mars has no permanent human settlement.

cases.statement: Coffee was first cultivated in Brazil.
cases.provenance: Adversarial knowledge tiebreaker: passage is about coffee (high similarity) but discusses production today, not where it was first cultivated. General knowledge places coffee's first cultivation in the Arabian peninsula / Ethiopia, not Brazil, so the verifier disputes it on basis knowledge.

passages.text: Brazil is today the world's largest producer of coffee, accounting for roughly a third of global output.

model_verdict.rationale: The passage covers current production; general knowledge places first cultivation in Arabia/Ethiopia, not Brazil.

cases.statement: The ozone layer over Antarctica grew by 40 percent in 2023.
cases.provenance: Adversarial: ozone passage (high similarity) discusses recovery trends generally but gives no figure for 2023, and no general knowledge can settle a precise year-specific percentage, so the verifier returns unverifiable with basis knowledge.

passages.text: The Antarctic ozone hole has shown signs of gradual recovery since the Montreal Protocol, though year-to-year size varies with weather.

model_verdict.rationale: The passage describes gradual recovery but gives no 2023 figure, and no general knowledge settles the specific percentage.

cases.statement: Most people slip into addiction gradually rather than all at once.
cases.provenance: Headline knowledge tiebreaker: the retrieved passage is about addiction but does not bear on the gradual-onset claim; the legacy path returns the equivalent of 'not enough info'. General understanding of addiction supports gradual onset, so the verifier returns credible with basis knowledge (no direct sources). This is the case the credibility reframe exists to get right.

passages.text: Addiction is characterized by compulsive substance use despite harmful consequences and by changes in brain reward circuitry.

model_verdict.rationale: No passage bears on gradual onset, but it is broadly consistent with the general understanding of how addiction develops.

cases.statement: The fictional city of Zelvoria held its annual lantern festival last spring.
cases.provenance: No relevant evidence is retrievable and no general knowledge can speak to a private, fictional event; the path must return unverifiable rather than guess.

model_verdict.rationale: No evidence passages address this claim and no general knowledge settles it.
